derivation: from G5571 (ψευδής) and a kindred form of G3144 (μάρτυς);
def: a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony

occurrences.text: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
